# Wireless-Sensor-Networks

> MATLAB simulator for wireless sensor networks (WSN). It models tree and star
> topologies, checks node-to-parent connectivity, detects the hidden terminal
> problem between sibling nodes, and estimates per-level and end-to-end packet
> delivery success probability from a radio link-budget / path-loss model.

Author: Mohsen Seyedkazemi Ardebili (mohsen.seyedkazemi@gmail.com)
Language: MATLAB
License: Apache-2.0
Repository: https://github.com/MSKazemi/Wireless-Sensor-Networks

## What it does

- Builds and plots a WSN topology from a parent vector (coordinator + nodes).
- Checks connectivity: a child connects to its parent when its maximum radio
  transmission distance (from the link budget) is at least the Euclidean distance.
- Detects the hidden terminal problem (HTP) between nodes that share a parent.
- Estimates packet delivery success probability per tree level and end-to-end.
- Uses a link-budget / path-loss radio model driven by transmit power, receiver
  sensitivity, antenna gains, path-loss exponent, and operating frequency (e.g. 2.4 GHz).

## Network model (treeNetModel)

- NodesParents: parent of each node (0 = coordinator/root)
- NodeLoc: node coordinates (2D or 3D)
- SensRange: sensing coverage range per node
- NodeP: per-node transmit power range (dBm) and receiver sensitivity (dBm)
- NodeBatt: battery energy per node (inf for the coordinator)
- Ch: radio channel; Gt/Gr: antenna gains (dB); Beta: path-loss exponent; f: frequency (Hz)

## Key files

- treeWSNsolverRun_V2.m: example run script (defines a sample tree and runs the solver)
- WSNsolver.m: dispatches to the star/tree/mesh solver by topology
- treeWSNsolver.m: tree solver (connectivity + hidden terminal analysis)
- pSuccessTree.m / Ps_L.m: packet delivery success probability (end-to-end / per-level)
- vectorToNodeParentLevelChilderen.m: derives node level and child counts
- treeNetplot.m: plots the network tree (adapted from MATLAB treeplot)
- conCheck.m / HTPCheck.m: connectivity and hidden-terminal link checks
- euclideanDis.m: 2D/3D Euclidean distance

## How to run

1. Add the repository folder to the MATLAB path.
2. Run `treeWSNsolverRun_V2` to simulate the sample tree network.
3. To analyse a custom network, edit the treeNetModel fields and call
   `WSNsolver(treeNetModel, 'tree')`.

## Notes

- The tree topology path is the most complete; star and mesh branches are stubs.
- Some referenced helpers (maxTxDis, starWSNsolver, meshWSNsolver) are not included.
- Pmac.m and probPortionSD.m return placeholder constants.
